help.skillHtml: Plans are made by Claude or ChatGPT. Download the trip-map skill and upload it in Claude under Settings → Capabilities → Skills, or add it to your skills in ChatGPT. Once your trip is planned, write something like “Export the plan to the map”. The assistant sends a small page with a button that opens the plan here.
help.replacing: A plan with the same name replaces the earlier one, so to update a plan, just open the new version.
help.iphoneHtml: On an iPhone, the link opens in the browser. To get it into the app on your home screen, use Import plan → Paste from clipboard.
